name: Gen1Recomp
description: Play Pokemon Red, Blue and Yellow natively on TrimUI handhelds. Bundles Gen1Recomp 0.1.77 and the Dramatic Shape voxel 3D mod. Needs your own US cartridge dump.
author: Carroarmato0

v0.1.0: Bundles Gen1Recomp 0.1.77 and the LOVE 11.5 aarch64 runtime.
Dramatic Shape voxel 3D mod included, off by default -- see the README for the Swap.pak setup it needs.
Reads your own Red/Blue/Yellow dump once from Roms/Game Boy (GB) or Roms/Game Boy Color (GBC); no ROM is shipped.
